sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Scaling Graph RAG from a 10,000-entity prototype to a 10M+ entity production system requires addressing three bottlenecks independently: **indexing throughput** (parallel LLM extraction, batched embeddings, distributed chunking), **graph storage and query latency** (sharding, connection pooling, index optimization, caching), and **retrieval latency** (approximate nearest neighbour search, pre-computed subgraphs, async Neo4j). The fundamental scalability challenge is that knowledge graphs are **highly interconnected** — you cannot simply partition them like relational databases, because cross-shard edge traversal destroys query latency. Solutions include **graph partitioning algorithms** (METIS, spectral partitioning) that minimize cut edges, **community-aware sharding** (each shard contains a complete community), and **read replicas** for query traffic. Horizontal scaling of the LLM extraction pipeline uses async semaphores, Redis-based work queues, and idempotent processing with content-hash deduplication.

sections.title: ④ Visual Explanation
sections.body:
```
         GRAPH RAG SCALABILITY ARCHITECTURE

  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                  QUERY LAYER                            │
  │  [Load Balancer] → 5× FastAPI instances                 │
  │  Each instance: 25 async coroutines                     │
  └───────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────┘
                          │
            ┌─────────────┼──────────────┐
            ▼             ▼              ▼
  ┌──────────────┐ ┌────────────┐ ┌───────────────┐
  │ REDIS CACHE  │ │  FAISS     │ │  NEO4J        │
  │              │ │  IVFFlat   │ │  READ REPLICAS│
  │ L1: answers  │ │            │ │               │
  │ L2: bfs      │ │ 1M entities│ │  Primary (W)  │
  │ L3: entities │ │ ~10ms ANN  │ │  Replica 1(R) │
  │ TTL: 1h-24h  │ │            │ │  Replica 2(R) │
  └──────────────┘ └────────────┘ │  Replica 3(R) │
                                  └───────────────┘

  SCALING MATH
  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Target: 100 QPS at 300ms p95                          │
  │                                                        │
  │  Cache hit (70%): 70 req → Redis (5ms) ✓              │
  │  Cache miss (30%): 30 req → full pipeline              │
  │                                                        │
  │  Full pipeline breakdown:                              │
  │  ├── Embedding:     20ms  (async, no GPU needed)      │
  │  ├── FAISS search:  10ms  (IVFFlat, 1M entities)      │
  │  ├── Neo4j BFS:    100ms  (3 read replicas)           │
  │  ├── Context build: 20ms  (CPU)                        │
  │  └── LLM generate: 150ms  (gpt-4o-mini, streaming)   │
  │  Total: ~300ms ✓                                       │
  │                                                        │
  │  Throughput: 5 API × 25 coroutines = 125 concurrent   │
  │  With 300ms latency → 125 / 0.3s = 416 QPS max ✓     │
  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
